newsitem.title: USA: General Signal earnings rise to $37.4 million.
newsitem.headline: General Signal earnings rise to $37.4 million.

text.p: General Signal Corp. said Monday its third quarter earnings rose nearly tripled to $37.4 million, or 75 cents a share.
That compared with net earnings of $12.8 million, or 26 cents per share, last year.
Wall Street analysts had predicted earnings of 69 cent per share for the third quarter of 1996.
Third quarter results got a boost from an increase in productivity of more than 5 percent over the prior year's third quarter, the company said.
"General Signal has met its commitments in the third quarter," Chairman Michael Lockhart said in a statement.

Lockhart said that with three quarters of the year behind it, the Stamford, Conn.-based company continued "to feel confident that we are on track to deliver, as previously targeted, earnings per share of $2.60."
General Signal was unchanged on the New York Stock Exchange at $41.875.
